question: For each department, show the department name and the average number of enrolled students for subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that have more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', but only include departments where this average is greater than the overall average number of enrolled students for such subjects across all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  WHERE at.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'
    AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
      WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
        AND lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'
    )
),
dept_avg AS (
  SELECT
    OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled
  FROM base
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS overall_avg
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  da.avg_enrolled
FROM dept_avg da
CROSS JOIN overall o
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON da.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE da.avg_enrolled > o.overall_avg
